name: tool-call-data
title: Tool Call Data
description: A tool call's input or output, to read, for a call the app has no view of its own for (e.g. an MCP tool's): a JSON object, as text or a value, as its fields, each its key beside its value (over it where narrow): text as text, wrapped, its lines kept, long text cut to 6 lines over "Show all"; a number, true, false or null as code; an object, an array or text that is one in JSON as a formatted JSON block folding past 8 lines. Other text is text, coloured in its language ("ansi" for a terminal's), folding past 12 lines. Its header has its title, the app's actions, a toggle to the JSON as it came (formatted, wrapped) and copy, which copies it as it came. mcpToolName reads an MCP tool's name (mcp__github__create_issue) as its server and tool, for the app's title.
